description: A simple mod that adds local and global chat channels to Minecraft

releases.notes:
## viaStyle 2.8.0 - viapanel 2.9.0 annotation API migration

### Changed
- Panel integration migrated from the legacy `ViaStylePanelProvider` (324 lines) to `@ViaPanelField` annotations: **103 fields across 19 sections**
- Registration via `ViaPanelProviders.builder(...)` with hooks:
  - `permission`: `viastyle.panel` (LuckPerms-first, OP 2 fallback)
  - `onFieldUpdated`: defaultLanguage handling, join/leave overrides, visual refresh for nick/nametag/tab/AFK
  - `languageHook`: en/ru normalization + placeholder localization
  - `onReload`: managers reload (Lang, JoinLeaveManager, TabListManager, NickColorManager)
- viapanel dependency is now resolved via `fileTree('../lib', 'viapanel-*.jar')`

### Removed
- `ViaStylePanelProvider.java` - replaced by annotations + core-managed lifecycle

### Requires
- viapanel **2.9.0+** at runtime: https://github.com/viaMeowts/viapanel/releases/tag/v2.9.0

**Requires:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Java 21

## Added

### Broadcast System
- New `/bc` command with configurable sound, cooldown, header/message formats, console sender support.
- Config section `[broadcast]` in viaStyle.toml (broadcastEnabled, cooldownSeconds, sound settings, format strings).
- ViaStylePanelProvider: Broadcast section with all broadcast fields.
- `BroadcastCommand.java` — full command implementation (`/bc <message>`, cooldown tracking, sound playback, console support).

### Chat Share Placeholders
- Players can type `[item]`, `[pos]`, `[inv]`, `[ec]` in chat to share held item, coordinates, inventory, or ender chest.
- Configurable cooldown (default 10s), max per message (default 4), inventory snapshot expiry (default 180s).
- Per-placeholder permission nodes (`viastyle.placeholder.item`, `.pos`, `.inv`, `.ec`).
- Localized hover/display text (EN/RU).
- `ChatSharePlaceholders.java` — full implementation with inventory/enderchest GUI viewers.
- New config fields in `[chat_placeholders]` section.

### Join/Leave System
- Per-player and per-group join/leave format overrides.
- Persisted to `config/viaStyle/joinleave-users.json`.
- `/joinleave` command to manage overrides in-game.
- viaPanel sections for Join/Leave and Join/Leave Overrides.
- `JoinLeaveManager.java` — data management with JSON persistence.
- `JoinLeaveCommand.java` — command with subcommands.

### PM Sound System
- Per-player PM sound toggle (`/msound`) — preference persists across restarts in `config/viaStyle/pm-sound.json`.
- `PmSoundCommand.java` — `/msound`, `/msound on|off`, `/msound status`.
- `viaStyle.playerPmSoundDisabled` set with JSON persistence (load/save helpers).

### AFK System
- Full automatic AFK detection with configurable timeout.
- Movement detection via player input state (`PlayerInput` record) — only WASD/jump/sneak resets AFK.
- AFK suffix appended to nametag, tab list, and chat.
- Configurable suffix content, colors, exempt players, bypass permission.
- `AfkManager.java` — tick-based idle tracking, player activity hooks.
- `AfkCommand.java` — `/afk`, `/afk <player>`, `/afk bypass <player>`, `/afk bypass list`.
- Config section `[afk]` with `afkSuffixEnabled`, `afkTimeout`, `afkSuffix`, `afkNameColor`, etc.

### Chat MiniMessage
- Players can use MiniMessage tags in chat (`<red>`, `<gradient:#ff0000:#ffaa00>`, etc.).
- Config toggle and optional permission gate (`viastyle.chat.minimessage`).
- `ChatMiniMessageParser.java` — lightweight MiniMessage tag parser for chat context.

### Placeholder View Command
- `/placeholders` command shows available chat placeholder tokens to the player.
- `PlaceholderViewCommand.java`

### ViaStylePanelProvider — New Sections
Added 19 viaPanel sections total, including new: Chat Formatting, Timestamp, Broadcast, Join/Leave, Join/Leave Overrides, viaSuper, AFK.

### Language System
- Expanded `Lang.java` with +311 lines — localized strings for all new features (broadcasts, placeholders, join/leave, AFK, PM sound, etc.).
- New `getRaw()` and `getColored()` methods for flexible text construction.
- Broadcast format localization (EN/RU templates).

## Changed

### Config Overhaul
- `ViaStyleConfig.java` reorganised with clear section separators and consistent field naming.
- Added config fields for: chat MiniMessage, PM sound/color/ban-hammer-mute, mention color/style, chat placeholders (all sub-fields), broadcast (all fields), join/leave (format strings), AFK (all fields), viaSuper (title/subtitle formats).
- New `applyLocalizedPlaceholderDefaults()` method for language-aware default templates.

### ChatHandler
- Removed ScarpetHelper integration.
- Added AFK activity reset on chat message send.
- Permission checks use new `checkPlayerPermission()` with proper precedence.
- Local chat delivers to a recipient list for mention radius filtering.
- Message processing pipeline now includes `ChatSharePlaceholders.processMessage()`.
- SocialSpy relay refactored to accept sender name string + optional exclude player.

viaStyle 2.6.8 for Minecraft 1.21.11.

This release ports the mod to 1.21.11 and updates dependency/runtime compatibility for the new command permission API and integration stack.

## What changed

- Updated project target to Minecraft 1.21.11.
- Updated Yarn mappings to 1.21.11+build.4.
- Updated Fabric Loader to 0.18.4.
- Updated Fabric API to 0.141.3+1.21.11.
- Migrated Vanish compile-only dependency to Modrinth Maven:
  - maven.modrinth:vanish:1.6.6+1.21.11
- Reworked OP-level fallback checks for the new 1.21.11 permission model
  (`PermissionPredicate` / `LeveledPermissionPredicate`) replacing removed `hasPermissionLevel(int)` calls.
- Kept existing optional integrations operational:
  - LuckPerms
  - BlockBot
  - Carpet/Scarpet
  - PlaceholderAPI
  - BanHammer
  - melius-vanish

## Build status

- Clean build completed successfully on 1.21.11.

## Artifacts

- Main jar: viastyle-2.6.8+mc1.21.11.jar
- Sources jar: viastyle-2.6.8+mc1.21.11-sources.jar

## Highlights

- Local, global, and staff chat channels with configurable formats
- Private messages (`/msg`, `/reply` and their aliases) and SocialSpy
- @mentions with highlight and optional sound ping
- Ignore system for chat and PM filtering
- Per-player nick color system with RGB and gradient support
- Tab list customization with dynamic sorting and Carpet HUD compatibility
- Join/leave and first-join custom messages
- BlockBot Discord bridge support (passthrough and custom formatting modes)
- In-game admin panel (`/viapanel`) with EN/RU localization
- Optional "Nobody heard you" local-chat feedback when no players are in range

## Integrations

LuckPerms · PlaceholderAPI · BlockBot · Carpet / Scarpet · BanHammer · Vanish

## Scarpet

New simple generator script included – generates ready-to-use templates:
logger, antispam, filter, discord queue, welcome, commands, stats

## Configuration

- Main config: `viaStyle.toml`
- Runtime edit and reload via `/viapanel` and `/viaStyle reload`

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader 0.16.12+
- Java 21+

## Notes

- Server-side only, no client mod required
- If upgrading from older builds, review `blockbot.passthrough` and mention-related settings in config
